summary: This file is a pure configuration dictionary (no functions, classes, or callable APIs). It defines an MMClassification model config for ResNeXt-152 32x4d with an ImageClassifier wrapper, GlobalAveragePooling neck, and LinearClsHead for 1000-class classification.

Override backbone/head parameters in downstream config files
